summary: New Found Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on July 6, 2026, providing an operational update on its Queensway Gold Project and Pine Cove mill in Newfoundland, Canada. The filing discusses regulatory milestones: the NL Minister of Environment requested an Environmental Preview Report for Queensway Phase 1 following the April 2026 environmental registration. Additionally, the company received a permit amendment to convert the Pine Cove mill from a flotation-leach circuit to a gravity-carbon-in-leach circuit, targeting increased recoveries. No financial terms, stakeholder changes, or corporate transactions are disclosed; this is a routine regulatory progress update, not a special situation.
